0022600130.text: The Sacramento Kings, 0-2 and on a two-game losing streak, are on the road in their fourth game of the season against the San Antonio Spurs, who are 1-2 and have won their last game. Sacramento sits 4th in the Pacific, 2.5 games back, and 14th in the West, while San Antonio is 3rd in the Southwest, 2 games back, and 9th in the West. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf, strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), and San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain). The teams have not played each other yet this season, and the Kings lost all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently 132-104 in Sacramento on March 17, 2026.
